comment: Milestone A.2. `src/shared/ipc.ts` derives its shapes from
@ledar/contracts through type-only imports, so this half has to be
able to resolve the package or the build cannot check the derivation.
It adds NOTHING to the browser bundle: `verbatimModuleSyntax` erases a
type-only import entirely, and `types: []` above still keeps Node's
globals out of the renderer. What it adds is the failure this app had
no way to produce before — a field renamed in contracts breaking
`tsc --build` on the RENDERER side, which is precisely the side that
had been reading a hand-written copy.
